title: fix(studio): kanban card click-to-open offers only Default and Don't open
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_
Fixes #35936

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 里编辑看板视图的作者:卡片设置「点击打开」以前列出四种方式,现在只列「默认」和「不打开」;已经存了侧边抽屉、记录页或新窗口的视图会显示该值并标「已弃用」,选「默认」即可清掉。
- 承接对象列表「打开记录」新规则(点名称进整页、悬停图标开侧边):列表视图上的打开方式已废弃,这里不再让作者选一个不生效的选项。
- 出错的话只影响这个下拉的显示,不改任何已存数据,打开视图不写入;可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- The kanban card section of Studio's list-view inspector (`KanbanCardSection` in `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`) offers `navigation.mode` as Default (no key) and `none` only. `drawer`, `page` and `new_window` parse on an object's list and change nothing since the deprecation in #35854, so they are no longer offered.
- A view that already stores one of those three draws it as one extra row, first, flagged with the existing `engine.form.deprecated` flag through `flagUnknownValue` (`drawer (deprecated)` / `drawer（已弃用）`), the same rule `InspectorSelectField` applies to a stored value its roster does not offer. Picking Default removes the key. Opening the view writes nothing. A value outside the spec union keeps its raw monospace row, as before.
- The studio catalogue (`en`, `zh`) drops `engine.studio.inspector.listView.kanbanCard.mode.drawer`, `.mode.page` and `.mode.newWindow`: the flagged row shows the stored value, not the old label, so nothing reads them.
- No spec change: `navigation.mode` stays as #35854 left it, and page blocks keep every mode.

**Read first** (by risk):
1. `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, the `OFFERED_NAVIGATION_MODES` constant and the click-to-open `SelectContent`: the only behaviour change.
2. `StudioDesignSurface.kanbanCardSelection-12725.test.tsx`, the new top-level `describe` "click to open offers only the default and none on an object's list".

**Two-minute check**: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.kanbanCardSelection-12725.test.tsx` prints `Tests  19 passed (19)`.

## Tests

- Rewritten: the case that picked `drawer` now picks `none` and expects `navigation: { mode: 'none' }`.
- New, in the file's shared harness (a fourth view `showcase_task.legacy` storing `navigation: { mode: 'drawer' }`):
  - a view with no stored mode lists exactly Default, Don't open;
  - a stored `drawer` shows on the trigger as `drawer (deprecated)`, the list is that row then Default, Don't open, and no draft is saved after the 1.5 s autosave debounce has passed;
  - picking Default saves the body without `navigation` (equal to the board's config) and it parses as `ListViewSchema`.

Readings on head `3bcbac0518` (shared box, all under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` except the `check:*` gates):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.kanbanCardSelection-12725.test.tsx`: `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  19 passed (19)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/`: `Test Files  105 passed (105)`, `Tests  1962 passed | 13 skipped (1975)`, exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablation (one, then restored)</summary>

Committed first, then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` re-offered `drawer` by adding `{ mode: 'drawer', … }` to `OFFERED_NAVIGATION_MODES` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `222e503bd324` to `dc45cfc280a8`). The file went red: `Tests  2 failed | 17 passed (19)`, the two failures being "a view with no stored mode is offered exactly the default and none" and "a stored drawer shows flagged deprecated, …". The tool restored the file: blob back to `222e503bd324`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Wording: the card asks for a row marked 「已废弃」; the row uses the existing sourced flag `engine.form.deprecated`, which reads 「（已弃用）」 in zh. Same meaning; reusing it avoids a second deprecated-flag dialect in the studio catalogue.
- The flagged row stays selectable (re-picking the current value changes nothing), as `InspectorSelectField` documents for every stale-value row, rather than disabled as the dispatch's suggested route proposed.
- The card names 11 locale packs. The three keys lived only in the studio namespace, which ships `en` and `zh` (every other language falls back to `en`), so they were deleted from those two files.
- Other Studio surfaces for an object list's `navigation.mode` (not page blocks): no other bespoke inspector offers the modes. The generic metadata form for a view labels `navigation.mode` from the spec's JSON Schema and its zh help text already says 「[已弃用]」; its select was not driven in a browser here (not measured), and it is not changed.
